lede: I'm a digital marketer, and AI is part of how I work every day within Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini, and Copilot. It takes on the slow, repetitive tasks and sits as another springboard for ideas.

blocks.h: From Calendar to Do's and Don'ts
p: At QAD Redzone and Cohesity I used AI across the editorial workflow: the content calendar in Monday.com, briefs and first drafts that I then edited, A/B tests, localized content, and do's and don'ts docs the whole team could follow.

I set up the calendar to do some of the work itself. Each item had a Generate button. Clicking it ran a Zapier workflow that sent the item to Claude, with instructions built from our do's and don'ts, and wrote the result back into the board for me to edit.

p: I was given raw footage for a Mars Men project: six takes, with two hooks, three body takes and a call to action. I started by giving ChatGPT the transcript of every take. It told me what to cut and helped me pick the hook. Then I cut the video in Premiere by deleting those lines from the transcript, used ChatGPT to find B-roll on Pexels that fit what I had in mind, and let AI make the captions for sound-off viewing.
blocks.note: Rebuilt for this page on the finished edit's own timeline and soundtrack, from the clean raw takes, with the color corrected, the B-roll's old captions painted out and new captions on top. The transcript is from the real takes, and the playhead and highlighted line follow the video.

lines.t: Forget all the biohacking trends. You don't need another cold plunge, red light therapy, or magic mushroom coffee.
Low testosterone isn't about seed oils or your sleep tracker, and it's definitely not your underwear.
Most guys are blaming everything but the problem.
The truth? Most men today are running from the real work.
We're out of alignment, stuck in jobs we hate, scrolling our lives away, and wondering why our energy and drive are gone.
You weren't built to be average. You're not here to be tired, soft, or overlooked. You're built to stand out,
to lead, to walk into any room and command respect. Nailed it.
Stop chasing hacks and dodging your own potential. When you fix your foundation, your hormones, your habits, your mindset, everything else falls into place.
You want to feel like a man again?
Start living like one. Own your routine. Own your health. Own your results.
Push yourself. Get aligned with your purpose. You're not broken, okay?
You're just not living up to the standard you were made for. Let's get after it.

p: At Cohesity I built an AI agent with Claude Code, loaded it with our style guide and brand guidelines, and built a localization feature into the Champions Hub. Employees could localize one post as they shared it to LinkedIn, or switch on the whole feed and browse every post in their own language and region, graphics included.

The agent adapted the region as much as the language: less US-centric, with the tone set for each place. Its versions came out about 99% ready. I reviewed them with my team and select Champion Advocates, and every fix went back to the agent so it learned.

blocks.h: Written for Search Engines and AI Answers
p: People type keywords into Google and ask ChatGPT full questions. GEO and AEO, generative and answer engine optimization, mean writing pages that work for both.

At QAD Redzone in 2024 I organized our FAQs and blogs so search engines and AI answers could find them. At Nike I wrote alt text and product tags for both kinds of search: for someone who knows exactly what they want, and for someone who only knows roughly.

blocks.h: Tools I Built With Claude Code and Codex
p: In the evenings I build my own apps with Claude Code and Codex. I tell them what I want in plain English, then test each build and decide how it should look and behave. I use all of these every day.

tools.name: heardhum
tools.line: A Mac menu bar app that records calls and saves timed transcripts with speaker labels, all on your Mac.

tools.name: Budget AI
tools.line: A budgeting app that runs on your own computer, with a review inbox, budgets that understand bills, and a Home Screen widget.

tools.name: Job Search AI
tools.line: A job search system that runs in your own Claude: it finds roles that fit, tailors a resume and cover letter for each, and tracks every application.

tools.name: Markup AI
tools.line: Comment threads on top of any app, answered by Claude. I mark up a design, and the change comes back in place.
